channel.title: Greg Airel — Blog
channel.description: Logistics notes, AI experiments, field guides, and the occasional mix.

item.title: Japan 2027 — A Field Guide in Progress
item.description: The plan, published while it is still a plan: ten nights riding the cherry blossom front south from Tokyo to Kyoto, with the full write-up to follow in April 2027.

item.title: Patagonia W Trek — A Personal Field Guide
item.description: Five days on the W circuit, written up afterwards — terrain day by day, the gear that earned its weight, and what to pack for a March departure.

item.title: Everest Base Camp — A Personal Field Guide
item.description: Ten days through the Khumbu — Lukla to Base Camp on foot, a helicopter out, and a pre-dawn climb up Kala Patthar to 5,555 m for the view everyone comes for.

item.title: Ninjazz Vol. 1
item.description: An old mix from the gregtron era — an hour of jazz and hip-hop stitched together into something mellow enough to work to and heavy enough to nod to. Fourteen years old and still holds up.
